claim: Portuguese contact with Kotte began with the 1505 voyage associated with Lourenço de Almeida; the first Portuguese fortress at Colombo was established in 1518, so 1505 should not be narrated as a Portuguese conquest of Colombo.
bounded_by: The exact wording and legal interpretation of the earliest tribute/protection agreement vary across Portuguese and Sinhalese traditions. The claim establishes sequence, not a single uncontested treaty narrative.
notes: Run41 correction to supplied cinnamon intakes. Prevents the anachronistic formulation 'Afonso de Albuquerque took Colombo in 1505'.
